review_type: Repository-owner-commissioned AI-assisted Econometrica numerical-methods advisory review
recommendation: Reject in the present form. A new, substantially narrower paper on certified finite-precision continuation construction in risk-sensitive linear-quadratic control could merit evaluation, but the present manuscript does not establish an Econometrica-level numerical method for the broad NBO program.

independent_review_execution.execution_basis: The committed verification script was executed against the downloaded source-bound R37 publication artifact.

blocking_findings: The complete neural theorem is an exact quadratic matrix-factor construction inside a risk-sensitive linear-quadratic model, not yet a general NBO numerical method.
The adaptive-cached experiment does not isolate adaptive precision from fixed-target inverse caching.
All methods are compared far below a nonbinding 1e-4 target rather than at matched certified accuracy.
The finite-precision result assumes exact products and solves plus factor-storage rounding and does not provide practical floating-point or total bit complexity.
The new construction is executed only in a two-dimensional, four-date, zero-simulation exact laboratory.
The strongest theorem is model-specific while the manuscript retains a broad controlled-diffusion and multi-application framing.
The economic payoff is too limited for Econometrica, and the structural solution remains substantially faster.
positive_findings: R37 is a coherent, immutable, review-ready source-and-evidence snapshot.
The precision-refresh theorem appears internally coherent under its stated assumptions.
Whole-step perturbation error, rectangular factors, and noncommuting starts are handled explicitly.
The warm-start construction is connected to an all-state, all-action policy bound in the stated recursive-risk economy.
The paper clearly distinguishes policy certification, neural construction, and complete-work comparison.
Adverse historical results and a strong structural comparator are retained.
Provenance, preservation, compilation, and source-freeze records are unusually strong.

limitations: The reviewer did not rerun or retime the eight original services; the committed clocks are treated as frozen observations.
The reviewer verified committed source/evidence records, comparison arithmetic, and a central exact matrix identity, not every line of every inherited theorem.
No population or hardware-general performance inference is drawn from the eight deterministic services.
No claim is made that the structural method dominates outside the declared risk-sensitive linear-quadratic economies.
This advisory review is not an Econometric Society editorial decision.
